contexts.text: To seal up the vision and the prophet () = to conclude the things said in the Word about the Lord, and to complete them. AE 375:18.

Seal up the things which the seven thunders have spoken, and write them not () = that these things are not committed to heart and received, until after the dragon... has been cast out of the World of Spirits. Explained. AE 604.
And set a seal upon him () = that communication with the rest has been completely taken away.
Seal not up the words of this prophecy () = that the Apocalypse must not be closed up, but opened. AR 947:3, Explained.
That to those who approach worthily, the Holy Supper is a sealing up and a seal, that they are sons of God.
That by all means there must be a sealing up...
